justification: Slice 2 of the brief enrichment plan: measured nearest-feature distances on the environmental No rows, contaminated-land nearest-site detail, mine-subsidence district name, numeric ANEF value, and the yield card's inputs ledger plus the named-missing-control explanation per the 3a/3b spec. Presentation of existing engine output only — the realistic_gfa computation is untouched. Live smoke on the four demo addresses shows exactly the four intended environmental additions per address and nothing else.

pre_impl.existing_data: All surfaced values already exist: proximity_m is measured by get_unique_overlays via PostGIS ST_Distance for covered-but-not-intersecting layers; fetch_contaminated_land already returns the nearest site with its measured distance; fetch_mine_subsidence returns the district name; fetch_anef_zone returns the numeric level; the two-phase yield ledger shipped in PR 563 so the yield work is inputs provenance and the missing-control message only.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Two of my own Slice-0 guards fired on this slice's first draft: attaching an informational reason to a legitimately-empty AUTHORITATIVE field is failure evidence per the DataField contract and got coerced to NOT_AVAILABLE (fixed by keeping legit-empty reason-free), and the all-failed assembly walk exposed that the ANEF path claimed a checked no-contour answer even when both lookups had errored (now NOT_AVAILABLE when either check failed).
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: flood joined the existing PROXIMITY_LAYERS frozenset so its distance is measured by the same covered-not-hit ST_Distance query — no new query shape and never an estimate. The residual WO-2 conflation (mine/contaminated/drinking rendering False at AUTHORITATIVE when the fetch FAILED, because the services return None for both no-hit and the callers dropped the failure flag) is fixed with the established _unwrap_or_default flag pattern while wiring the detail fields.

functions.name: _build_environmental
functions.input: controls, overlay data with proximity_m, the raw mine/contaminated/drinking dicts plus their fetch-failure flags
functions.output: EnvironmentalConstraints with nearest_features, contaminated_detail, mine_subsidence_district, anef_level populated three-state
functions.if_none: a failed mine/contaminated/drinking fetch renders NOT_AVAILABLE with a reason, never a confident False; genuinely-outside stays False at AUTHORITATIVE

functions.name: _anef_fields
functions.input: the covered overlay value or the two live ANEF lookups, tracking whether each lookup actually ran
functions.output: a display string field and a numeric level field from one lookup pass
functions.if_none: no-contour is only claimed when both checks genuinely ran; a failed lookup returns NOT_AVAILABLE for both fields

functions.name: _parse_anef_number
functions.input: the raw ANEF value which may be an int, a float, a numeric string or a range like 20-25
functions.output: the leading number as float, or None when no clean number leads the value
functions.if_none: None means no numeric contour is claimed — never a guessed midpoint

values.if_missing: non-numeric values are dropped in _build_environmental and an empty map is the legit-empty state — a distance is never estimated or fabricated

queries.purpose: nearest mapped feature distances for covered layers not intersecting the lot, now including flood
queries.where_clause: WHERE layer_type IN (covered-not-hit set) AND lga_name = %s GROUP BY layer_type — parameterised, read-only

break_it.scenario: The mine subsidence lookup times out on a lot that IS in a proclaimed district
break_it.what_happens: Previously the card said No at AUTHORITATIVE (a confident wrong answer); now the failure flag renders NOT_AVAILABLE with a retry reason for both the boolean and the district name

break_it.scenario: Both ANEF lookups error on a property that actually sits under a flight path
break_it.what_happens: Previously the card claimed No published ANEF contour at this property off two failed checks; now either lookup failing renders NOT_AVAILABLE and the no-contour claim needs both checks to have genuinely run

break_it.scenario: A junk non-numeric proximity value arrives from the overlay layer for a nearest feature distance
break_it.what_happens: It is dropped in the builder rather than rendered as a distance — the No row shows plain No instead of a nonsense measurement
break_it.how: isinstance numeric filter over proximity_m in _build_environmental; test_junk_proximity_value_is_dropped_not_rendered_as_distance

break_it.scenario: An informational reason is attached to a legitimately-empty AUTHORITATIVE field (no nearby features to measure)
break_it.what_happens: The Slice-0 DataField validator reads a reason on a null value as failure evidence and coerces it to NOT_AVAILABLE, which would surface a false gap line — legit-empty fields now carry no reason and the fixture test pins it
break_it.how: reason only set on genuine failure for nearest_features and contaminated_detail; test_no_proximity_is_legit_empty_not_failure

break_it.scenario: The LEP maps neither an FSR nor a height control (Bowral, Wingecarribee LEP 2010) so the envelope cannot compute
break_it.what_happens: The yield card previously rendered nearly empty with no explanation; it now names the exact missing controls, the instrument, and that the DCP which sets the built form is not onboarded — composed entirely from data already in the stream
break_it.how: EnvelopeGap composed in buildYieldLedgerContext from the null lep_fsr/lep_height_m plus zone_epi and the dcp_controls state; confirmed on the live Bowral smoke run
break_it.repro: run the brief for 38 Park Road Bowral and open the Development Yield card

post_merge.db_reset: none — the proximity query is read-only and parameterised; flood only joins the existing IN-list
post_merge.other_repo: none — new environmental fields and card props pass through the Trigger.dev relay transparently
post_merge.manual_verify: after Railway deploys from main, run the brief for 38 Park Road Bowral (named-missing-control ledger + flood 45 m distance) and 14 Stanley St Concord (full computed ledger with inputs and sources)
